steps.content: On the highest hillside overlooking the farland camp, Hypatia finds a graveyard of old machines.
The equipment is old, obsolete models from decades past, their casings eaten away by sand and time, leaving rusted guts exposed to the wind.

steps.speaker: Young Engineer
steps.content: Donald

steps.speaker: Young Engineer
steps.content: The gear from Furor is much more advanced, but we don't really understand it. We salvaged it, but... if you know how to activate it, miss, that would be awesome...

Before the pitch-black devices, the truth becomes starkly clear. The farland salvagers didn't comprehend the full scope of what they were taking; they saw function, not design, not knowing these machines were only skeletons of a greater whole.
Now, with the Tide of Ashes imminent, their last hope is nothing but an elegant ruin.

steps.speaker: Young Engineer
steps.content: Miss Assistant, is there a way to fix it? Just tell me what you need! I'll find the materials!
Hypatia can't bring herself to tell them the truth. She turns instead, letting her eyes pass over the equipment half-erased by wind and time.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...There is one way.
She raises a hand. From her sleeve, a single filament of gold descends, touching the earth, then spreads in all directions like a rose unfurling across the ground.
Aurum Secretum flows into the old machinery, bathing each dormant piece in a soft, luminous sheen.

Though the machines no longer function, their core materials endure. By harmonizing these components with the Aurum Secretum through resonant alignment, a barrier may yet be formed—one large enough to shield the entire camp.
Dissolution, deformation, reconstruction, and finally, resonance!
BUZZZZZ—
A low, gathering hum swells into a sky-shaking roar as the nearly derelict pile of guardian machinery shudders back to life.

Streams of golden light surge through long-dormant conduits, weaving into radiant bands overhead. They knit together into a vast, shimmering dome that envelops the entire settlement. Even through the battered roof, the storm's howl falls completely silent.
Below, those caught in panic slow to a halt. They stare upward, awestruck by the golden canopy, their fear—for a moment—forgotten.

steps.speaker: Young Engineer
steps.content: This... this is... a miracle...

steps.speaker: Elder Engineer
steps.content: How did she... it was all beyond repair... but...
A stunned silence hangs in the air, then shatters into roaring cheers. The crowd surges toward the platform, voices rising in a tumult of awe and gratitude for Hypatia's miracle.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: N-no! It's not like that! I don't have any special power. This is just Aurum Secretum technology, that's all... I merely...
She shakes her head, her gaze flickering nervously across the faces watching her.
[Small CG: Rust in the Crowd]
Rust stands amid the crowd, yet feels worlds apart.
Ash dusts his shoulders, drifting from him like silent snow.
His gaze drops, then lifts again. It's deliberately casual, as if nothing held his eye. A faint smile touches his lips, and he melts back into the throng.
It is Yokna who stills the celebration. She parts the crowd with quiet authority and steps before Hypatia, her expression solemn.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: You have shielded our camp. Honored guest, what is your name?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: My name is... Tia...

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Good! Ms. Tia, here in the farlands, the Aurum Secretum is a heavenly blessing. Those who wield it are champions in our eyes.
She turns to face the crowd. Her voice rings out, a command that stills the air.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Today, during the Tide of Ashes, Ms. Tia protected us with the Aurum Secretum. We of the farlands honor our debts. No matter how dire our circumstances, we will never neglect the one who saved us!

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Everyone! Bring out the finest drink we have! Light the bonfires! Tonight, we celebrate our friends who have come to us from afar!

steps.speaker: Everyone
steps.content: Yes!!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Huh... Whaaaat???
[Night Scene]

The ash clears with the coming of sunset. Beneath the dome of shimmering light, people move with the weariness of the wounded. However, their toasts are loud, their drinks splashing over battered hands as they laugh through the pain.
Half the settlement seems to have gathered, voices rising in animated retellings of the day's terror and the miracle Hypatia wrought.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Ms. Tia, come here.
Yokna stands in the center of the carpet, her hand outstretched toward Hypatia in invitation.

The girl hesitates. She has seen farland celebrations before, from the edges as an observer. She knows the central seat is reserved for the guest of honor, surrounded by offered blessings with dance one by one.
But does she... truly deserve that spot?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Go on. What you did for them today deserves everyone's gratitude.
Guided gently from behind and welcomed from the front, Hypatia is ushered into the celebration beneath the shimmering golden dome.
Laughter and song rise around her. People move to a rhythmic dance, each taking her hands in turn, their words of gratitude warm and earnest.
Thanks to the Aurum Secretum, thanks to our savior, thanks to the fate that spares us one more day from the catastrophe's grasp.
May your heart be light, may your path be straight, may your destiny be fulfilled when you arrive...

Unlike the perpetual decorum of the nobility, this revelry feels raw and real, possessing a magic of its own. The drumbeats, the dancing, the shared blessings... each one weaving a stronger bond between them.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Destiny...
Pain, sudden and searing, lances through the brand on her neck. A cruel reminder, it scorches away any sense of worth.
Guilt, sharp and suffocating, rises in her throat. Through the heart-piercing pain, she clutches the communicator on her chest.
A gentle white light kindles within it, seeping warmth into her ribs, quieting the fire in her skin, easing the weight in her lungs.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: My power cannot remove it completely, but it can alleviate its flare-ups to some extent. To eliminate it entirely will require time... and your own willpower.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Thank you, Ms. Margaret.
Hypatia keeps a hand pressed to her chest as the burning fades. Around her, the celebration continues, with faces glowing like embers in the bonfire's light.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: What's wrong? Did someone offend you? Or are you feeling unwell?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No, it's just... I’m touched. I don't feel I've done anything remarkable, yet you all honor me so...

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Silly girl, surviving a catastrophe is the most remarkable. You saved lives; you've earned the best seat and the finest drink!
With a warm smile, she guides Hypatia to her seat.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Rust, where'd you find this one? You brought her all the way out here just out of the goodness of your heart to help us?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We're friends, aren't we? If I were in a pinch, you'd lend a hand.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: My friend here happens to be an exceptional Aurum Secretum researcher. Feel free to ask her anything you don't understand.
With a smooth swirl of his wine, Rust seizes the moment, introducing Hypatia to Yokna.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yokna and I go way back. Helping her is like helping me. Consider this your way to repay me for that rough journey: lend them your expertise.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I would have done it regardless!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No matter what, I will ensure the Aurum Secretum barriers remain stable and protect everyone here.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Thank you, truly. The Tide of Ashes has been worsening, costing us more lives each time. Without your help today, we would have lost many more.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: The farlands lack everything: technology, resources, skilled hands... And we're at a critical juncture. Who knows if spies have already slipped in... If you two could stay, it would be an immense help.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The place seems plenty lively as it is.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: It's that alliance meeting... Every power player has shown up, thrown this place into chaos. The bootlicking merchants are manageable; they just want profit. But I'm more worried about the warmongers, in and out all the time, scheming who-knows-what.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Every time I see that lot, I want to tell 'em to stop stirring the damn pot. Just dealing with Mania is hard enough. We can't survive another ******* war.
Before the words have fully left her mouth, the thud of heavy footsteps crushes the festive air.

A dozen figures emerge from the narrow passage. Black blood gleams wet on their blades; cold light glints off their metal masks. Aurum Secretum Warriors, fresh from the kill, trailing the scent of death.
